name: Sandruu
description: A latent planeswalker and Feroz's apprentice exiled by Taysir.

description_citations.text: "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel lures six planeswalkers to Corondor with the Mox Beacon and forces them to battle in the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Ravidel used an artifact known as the Mox Beacon to lure other planeswalkers to Corondor.

citation.text: "Corondor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir attacked the returning Sandruu and defeated him.
timeline.quote: Taysir defeated Sandruu but was then attacked by a friend of the exiled planeswalker, Feroz .

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Anaba Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel manipulates Sandruu with misleading images of Kristina and Jared, enraging him.
timeline.quote: Showing Sandruu misleading images of Kristina with Jared, he stoked the minotaur’s fury.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jared retrieves Geyadrone Dihada's spellbook at Castle Melmereth despite Sandruu's interference.
timeline.quote: Though he struggled, Jared managed to escape with the spellbook.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat gathers the fragments of the Grey Chime; Kristina, Sandruu and Freyalise assault Telemar.
timeline.quote: Kristina, Sandruu, and Freyalise launched their assault on Telemar.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir reconciles with Sandruu, and Teferi and Eskil free Daria from the Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Teferi retrieved Daria's Amber Prison, and with Eskil’s help, freed her at last.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jared and Sandruu duel in Castle Melmereth; Jared escapes with Dihada's spellbook.
timeline.quote: Still, Jared manages to evade Sandruu long enough to escape with the spellbook.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir arrives in Corondor, seeks Kristina, and flees on learning she has another lover.
timeline.quote: Realizing that Kristina has taken yet another lover, Taysir flees, hurt and confused.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sandruu disintegrates Grenfell Mor; Freyalise separates Szat from the Chime and Leshrac decides to activate it.
timeline.quote: Grenfell nearly kills Kristina with a spell but is then disintegrated by Sandruu.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel enrages Sandruu with out-of-context images of Jared and Kristina, sending him to find Jared.
timeline.quote: This is enough to send Sandruu into a rage

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Wishes, Lies & Dreams , by D. G. Chichester and Mark Buckingham". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel tells Taysir that Kristina has taken a lover, provoking Taysir to attack Sandruu.
timeline.quote: Ravidel gleefully brought him the news that Kristina had taken a lover

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Manipulating Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ulgrotha Sandruu is banished and Taysir is slain by Feroz.
timeline.quote: Taysir was slain by the guardian of the Homelands, Feroz

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Manipulating Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir attacks Sandruu, banishes him to a remote plane, and is killed by Feroz on Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: killed him by splitting his skull with a broadsword.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "First death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz arrives and falls in love with Serra; Baron Sengir moves against them; Feroz founds the Wizards' School.
timeline.quote: with whom he quickly fell in love

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir follows Sandruu to Ulgrotha, defeats and exiles him, and is then defeated by Feroz.
timeline.quote: Their duel was won by Taysir, who exiles Sandruu to a remote plane.

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
